mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${table} (date, gross_sales, discounts, service_fee, tax, adj_amount, tender_amount, diners, tables_used, returning_customers, new_customers) VALUES (#{d.date}, #{d.gross_sales}, #{d.discounts}, #{d.service_fee}, #{d.tax}, #{d.adj_amount}, #{d.tender_amount}, #{d.diners}, #{d.tables_used}, #{d.returning_customers}, #{d.new_customers})

INSERT INTO ${table} (date, day_name, c_beverage, c_kitchen, c_grab, c_foodpanda, c_shopee) VALUES (#{c.date}, #{c.day_name}, #{c.c_beverage}, #{c.c_kitchen}, #{c.c_grab}, #{c.c_foodpanda}, #{c.c_shopee})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(supply_to_j2), 0) AS supply_to_j2, COALESCE(SUM(supply_to_j3), 0) AS supply_to_j3 FROM j1_supply WHERE date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
SELECT id, restaurant, `year_month`, current_stock FROM cost_month_stock WHERE restaurant = #{restaurant} AND `year_month` = #{yearMonth} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cost_month_stock (restaurant, `year_month`, current_stock) VALUES (#{m.restaurant}, #{m.year_month}, #{m.current_stock}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE current_stock = VALUES(current_stock)
